tickets.title: Reconcile and land the stranded depth work and audit docs
tickets.problem: The full-standard depth pass lives on ten unmerged *-full branches; main still shows 491/614 items flagged. Two audit docs exist only on branches. main has its own QA edits, so a blind merge would clobber them.
tickets.why_it_matters: The depth problem is unlanded, not unwritten - highest-leverage P0, and a credibility risk (claimed state != deployed state).
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every *-full branch merged (keeping main's QA fixes) or closed as superseded with a reason; both audit docs under docs/; fresh content:coverage on main shows flags drop to the branches' level; no silent force-pushes.
tickets.definition_of_done: main coverage matches intended full-standard state; no depth work remains only on a branch; decisions.md notes the reconciliation.

tickets.title: The Song Meaning surface (per-song deep view)
tickets.problem: No home for 'what does this song mean?'. TrackNote is a one-line hook (flat TrackRow); no meaning essay, lyric snippet, song links, or 'what Taylor said'.
tickets.why_it_matters: Highest single content lever; turns the Track Guide from an index into a destination.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Tapping a TrackRow opens a per-song detail with: original-words meaning (2+ paragraphs, sourced); short lyric snippets <=300 chars, never full song; relatedIds to connected songs; cited 'what Taylor has said'. Phased rollout, flagship/most-searched songs first.
tickets.data_model_implications: Extend TrackNote with optional meaning, lyricSnippets[{line,source}], relatedIds[], commentary[{quote,source}]. Excerpt >=300 hard-fail already guards the snippet cap.
tickets.definition_of_done: Detail renders for songs with new fields; others keep the one-liner; a phase-1 set authored+sourced; gates green.

tickets.title: Sync the theories seed to a live Theory surface
tickets.problem: theories/** is fully authored with required confidence+outcome and is better structured than the in-repo EGG_NODES the Clue Web renders - and has zero UI reach.
tickets.why_it_matters: Closes a major depth gap with content that already exists and passes gates; unifies two divergent theory datasets.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Theories render with confidence+outcome badges (reuse the pill); fact/theory stay structurally separated; no ambiguous double source of truth vs EGG_NODES.
tickets.data_model_implications: UI Theory type mirroring vault-types.ts; decide if EGG_NODES becomes a projection of the seed.
tickets.definition_of_done: Every seed theory reachable in the UI; badges correct; coverage green.

tickets.title: Sync the videos seed + wire the era video rail to it
tickets.problem: ~10 signature moments have a video vs 62 real MVs; the 65-record videos/** seed is unsynced.
tickets.why_it_matters: Video rail is a natural Cultural-Impact + Shareability surface running at ~15% coverage.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Era videos render from the seed via verified oEmbed facades (click-to-play, youtube-nocookie); no unverified IDs; filmography/TV/commercials out of scope pending the decision on where they live.
tickets.data_model_implications: UI Video type; MomentVideo may generalize to read the synced set.
tickets.definition_of_done: Era rails show seeded MVs; IDs verified; gates green.

tickets.title: Sync tours + releases seeds to the live UI
tickets.problem: Both pipelines are seeded (6 tours w/ Eras leg+show detail; 29 releases) and unsynced; the Eras date ledger has nowhere to render.
tickets.why_it_matters: Unlocks tour/release depth already written; feeds Timeline and Cultural-Impact.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Tour + release records render live; Eras leg/show data visible; no schema regressions.
tickets.definition_of_done: Records reachable in the UI; gates green.

tickets.title: Extend content-coverage.mjs: knowledge-graph density + pipeline-reach gates
tickets.problem: The gate measures body length, sources, media rights, and policy hard-fails, but not cross-link density or whether a seeded pipeline reaches the UI - the two things this audit found most broken.
tickets.why_it_matters: Turns the audit into a standing guardrail so 'authored but unreachable/unlinked' can't recur silently.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Report-only (no new hard-fail): (a) graph density - count records with relatedIds (reads row.relatedIds ?? row.moment?.relatedIds); (b) pipeline reach - for each seed type report whether a *.generated.ts exists (flags theories/videos/tours/releases as seeded-unsynced); (c) optional branch-vs-main drift reminder.
tickets.definition_of_done: New sections print; exit behavior unchanged; CI stays green.

tickets.title: Awards as a structured corpus
tickets.problem: Awards covered only as scattered narrative; source lists 690 wins / 1,640 nominations with no award-entry schema. T17 can't close without one.
tickets.why_it_matters: Awards are a bounded, enumerable Tier-1 completeness axis.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: An Award shape (body, year, work, category, result, source_url); a first import of major bodies (Grammy/AMA/VMA/CMA/Billboard); coverage per body. Scope decision required first.
tickets.data_model_implications: New Award type + seed dir + coverage expectations.
tickets.definition_of_done: Award records render + are gated; scope decision logged.

tickets.title: Media rights-status backfill + missing credits
tickets.problem: 707/751 media refs carry no rights-status; 7 detail photos have no credit. The rights-aware media shape (audit S5) was specified, not applied.
tickets.why_it_matters: Rights-status + credit keep the (now permissive) media policy defensible; also unblocks a clean T15 gallery.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every media ref gets rights (oembed|owned|hotlink_legacy) + a credit; the 7 uncredited photos fixed; coverage 'missing rights-status' -> 0.
tickets.data_model_implications: Apply the S5 rights-aware media object; missing fields treated as hotlink_legacy.
tickets.definition_of_done: Rights report clean; no AI-fake images; reference stand-ins still labeled.

tickets.title: Land the known factual corrections + the rel-5 era mislabel
tickets.problem: QA spot-check found real errors (Rascal Flatts date [fixed on main via unmerged #114], Vienna '250,000 tickets', Getty-vs-Taylor engagement-photo credit, 90k 'Angels' wording) mostly corrected only on branches; rel-5 still mis-filed under Red.
tickets.why_it_matters: Exactly the errors a real fan clocks instantly.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Each flagged claim on main corrected or softened to its source; rel-5 era corrected + sourced + vagueness convention applied; folds into T18 where overlapping.
tickets.definition_of_done: QA spot-check flags all resolved on main.

tickets.title: De-thin and source the Relationships and Runway threads
tickets.problem: Relationships have no sources and one sentence each; Runway is one look per era with 11/12 missing designer/occasion. Both feed Crossings.
tickets.why_it_matters: Two of six threads score <2.0 and drag Crossings with them.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: sources on every relationship; multiple dated occasion-specific runway looks per era (Showgirl is the template); relationship naming convention applied consistently (needs decision first).
tickets.data_model_implications: Add sources?: EggSource[] to Relationship and RunwayLook; optional designer/occasion on RunwayLook.
tickets.definition_of_done: Both threads sourced+de-thinned; Crossings visibly richer.

tickets.title: Empty-filter state gets a one-tap Clear filter
tickets.problem: 'No moments match that filter in this era.' is a dead end.
tickets.why_it_matters: Removes a small friction point on the main feed.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: The empty state offers a one-tap clear-filter action.

tickets.title: Thread gallery cards preview their depth
tickets.problem: Cards show title + kicker + one line; no sense of what's inside.
tickets.why_it_matters: Previews depth before the click; improves Shareability/Replay.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Each card shows an item count + one representative highlight.

tickets.title: Trim the 4 over-cap verbatim excerpts
surface_files: 4 moment.context fields flagged >=300 chars by content:coverage
tickets.problem: 4 verbatim pull-quotes exceed the 300-char excerpt cap (below the 600 hard-fail, so off-policy not blocking).
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Each trimmed to <=300 or converted to original-words summary + link; coverage 'verbatim excerpts >=300' -> 0.

tickets.title: Ask the Vault - worker-side semantic search (AI; decision-gated)
surface_files: new worker per docs/architecture.md AI rules
tickets.problem: The corpus is rich but only keyword-searchable (once T7 lands); natural-language queries aren't answerable.
tickets.why_it_matters: Natural-language recall over 600+ items is a real superfan differentiator.
tickets.architecture_constraint: Worker-side only, hard-capped, rule-based fallback (keyword search) when model unavailable/over-budget, never synchronous per request, decision-log cost entry before shipping. Precompute embeddings offline; no live per-request model calls in the reader.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: NL queries resolve to real corpus items with sources; fallback works with the model disabled; cost entry logged.
tickets.data_model_implications: Offline-built embedding index over the corpus.
tickets.definition_of_done: Feature behind the constraint; decision logged.

tickets.title: Editor aid: suggested relatedIds (AI; offline batch)
tickets.problem: Building the knowledge graph (T9) by hand across 600+ items is slow.
tickets.why_it_matters: Accelerates the connective-tissue work that the app's value depends on.
tickets.architecture_constraint: Offline batch only; suggestions are proposals a human accepts, never auto-written; no runtime model calls.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: A script proposes candidate relatedIds; a human accepts/rejects; nothing auto-commits.
tickets.definition_of_done: Script produces reviewable suggestions; no auto-commit.
